text: Guderley収束衝撃波：固有値と球対称の半解析参照 Guderley converging shock: eigenvalue and spherical semi-analytic reference Guderley収束衝撃波：固有値と球対称の半解析参照 R_s(t)=0.6*(-t)^alpha, alpha=1/lambda; x=t*(0.6/r)^lambda; rho=rho0*R(x), u=-r*V(x)/(lambda*t), p=rho*(-r*C(x)/(lambda*t))^2/gamma. For r<R_s:rho=rho0,u=p=0. 理想気体Eulerの球半径対称、γ=1.4、未衝撃上流ρ0=1,u=p=0。Lazarus時間t∈[-1,-.85]、r∈[0,.75]、R_s(t)=.6(-t)^α、α=1/λです。原点収束t=0は区間外で、初期場の外側には衝撃後の相似状態があります。λは固定ExactPackの固有値探索と元stateの8点照合で求めた資格確認済みの保存値を通常追試で再利用し、相似ODE・Gauss16/32球殻求積・Euler計算は再実行します。固有値探索と元ソース点照合の再生成は別の明示コマンドです。衝撃で積分を分けた保存量の体積平均からpを求め、原始圧力の平均と区別します。閉形式の厳密セル平均や独立に実装した相似解とは呼びません。図は1D球半径結果の2D子午面表示で、2D Cartesianや反射後の計算ではありません。 Guderley converging shock: eigenvalue and spherical semi-analytic reference R_s(t)=0.6*(-t)^alpha, alpha=1/lambda; x=t*(0.6/r)^lambda; rho=rho0*R(x), u=-r*V(x)/(lambda*t), p=rho*(-r*C(x)/(lambda*t))^2/gamma. For r<R_s:rho=rho0,u=p=0. Ideal-gas Euler in spherical radial symmetry, gamma=1.4, with unshocked upstream rho0=1, u=p=0. Lazarus time t in [-1,-0.85] excludes collapse at 0; r in [0,0.75], Rs(t)=0.6*(-t)^alpha and alpha=1/lambda. The initial field already contains the shocked outer similarity state. Lambda was computed and qualified using pinned ExactPack eigenvalue shooting and eight original-state probes. Routine replay reuses that recorded lambda and freshly integrates the same pinned pre-collapse similarity ODE. Full eigenvalue and original-probe regeneration is a separate explicit command. Shells are split at the shock and conserved states are Gauss16 volume averaged, checked against Gauss32; pressure is p(Ubar). This is a dense-output adapter to ExactPack, not closed-form exact cell means or an independent similarity implementation.
